title: U.S. Treasury's Bessent, China's He to hold talks on AI, trade, critical minerals ahead of Trump-Xi summit
summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng met at JPMorgan HQ in New York to prepare for the September 24 Trump-Xi White House summit. Key topics: extension of the trade truce set to expire November 10, AI chip controls, tariff reductions, and rare-earth/critical-minerals access.
why: 贸易休战11月10日到期，延续与否是近期最大宏观变量；AI芯片管制的松紧直接影响持仓中国科技标的估值；港股、A股消费/科技板块短期情绪面利好，关注峰会实质成果。

title: Investors react to Fed hike and market sell-off: Brace for 'higher for longer' rates
summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh led the FOMC in a unanimous 25bp rate hike to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16 — the first hike in over three years. Warsh's phrase 'timelier return' to the 2% inflation target spooked markets: Dow fell 631.21 points, S&P 500 -0.45%. The dot-plot projects one more 25bp hike this year.
why: 延续报道：首次加息后'higher for longer'预期持续发酵，高利率压制美股科技估值；对持仓Sell Put策略而言，波动率上升利好权利金收入，但下行风险也加大；关注本周特朗普-习近平峰会能否提振风险偏好形成对冲。

title: Bitcoin rises above $81,000 while NEAR jumps 23% on Zcash swap traffic
summary: Bitcoin traded above $81,000 on September 21, with crypto assets outperforming US equities. Macro backdrop: US 2-year Treasury yield remains elevated at around 4.76%, Brent crude near $102/barrel amid Middle East tensions and partial recovery in Saudi supply. Crypto's relative strength persists despite Fed tightening.
why: BTC涨至81000美元，加密资产相对大盘明显跑赢；Circle/CRCL持仓受益于USDC生态增长与BTC强势双重催化；宏观风险：美联储'higher for longer'背景下加密市场抗跌性值得关注，对Sell Put期权时机有参考意义。

title: US stocks open higher Monday as investors look ahead to Trump-Xi summit; Dow posts third straight losing week
summary: S&P 500 futures rose 0.3% and Nasdaq futures climbed Monday, September 20, as market sentiment improved ahead of the US-China high-level talks and the September 24 Trump-Xi summit. The Dow Jones had posted its third consecutive losing week on Friday, weighed down by higher-for-longer rate concerns after the September 16 Fed rate hike.
why: 美股开盘走高但仍处于连续三周下跌后的反弹测试；贸易峰会前市场情绪改善对港股/A股跨市场正相关；同时作为item1的市场背景item，反映了当日股市整体环境，两条合并理解中美谈判前夕市场情绪。

title: Emerging market stocks and currencies gain after US-China talks described as 'very successful'
summary: Emerging market equities and currencies rallied on September 21 after the Bessent-He talks were described as 'very successful' by both sides, boosting risk appetite ahead of the September 24 Trump-Xi summit. EM indices broadly advanced, with Hong Kong and mainland China markets outperforming; the offshore yuan strengthened.
why: EM资产全面上涨，港股/A股领涨，体现中美关系缓和预期的直接市场反应；离岸人民币走强利好持仓中国资产的汇兑表现；这是谈判消息（item1）在市场层面的价格验证，两条互为印证。

title: Share Buyback Roundup for September 18: Tencent repurchased 237,000 shares for approximately HK$100 million
summary: On September 18, Tencent Holdings (00700.HK) repurchased 237,000 ordinary shares at prices ranging from HK$425.2 to HK$430.2 per share, totalling approximately HK$100 million. The company has maintained near-daily HK$100M repurchases in September under its general mandate approved May 13, 2026.
why: 腾讯持续高频回购（9月每个交易日约HK$1亿），显示管理层护盘意愿强烈；当前股价约425-430港元，较近期高点有所回落；对于Sell Put策略，回购带来的价格支撑降低了行权被动接货的风险，高频回购亦有利于期权时间价值消耗。
